roles.name: CEO
roles.goal: Check business overview, risk, revenue impact, project health, and decision summary.

roles.name: Admin
roles.goal: Check full control, permission, settings, user management, and system configuration.

roles.name: Marketing
roles.goal: Check content edit, link edit, publish flow, scheduling, image upload, campaign flow.

roles.goal: Check simple user experience, mobile usability, clear buttons, error states, and completion flow.
